Sub: Intimation of scheduled investors and analysts meet/events 
 
Dear Sir / Madam,  
 
Pursuant to the Regulation 30 read with Schedule III Part A Para A 15a of the Securities and Exchange 
Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“Listing 
Regulation”), we hereby inform that the Company will be participating in the investor and analyst 
meet/events as mentioned below: 
 
Day and Date 
Place 
Particulars 
Mode 
Meeting Type 
Friday, 
14th August, 
2026 
Mumbai 
Equirus Annual India Conference, 
2026

One-on-one & 
Group meeting 
Tuesday, 
18th August, 
2026 
Mumbai 
Motilal Oswal 22nd Annual Global 
Investor Conference, 2026 
Physical 
One-on-one & 
Group meeting 
 
The same will also be available on the Company’s website, at www.lloyds.in.  
 
Note:  
 
1. The date of the aforesaid meeting/events is subject to change due to exigencies on the part of 
Investors/Company.  
2. No Unpublished Price Sensitive Information will be shared at the above-mentioned meeting(s). 
 
The same may please be taken on record and suitably disseminated to all concerned. 
 
Thanking you. 
 
Yours faithfully.  
For Lloyds Metals and Energy Limited 
 
 
 
Akshay Vora
